sources.title: Public Holidays Act, Cap. 23.23 (Revised Laws, revision date 31 December 2002), Schedule and s. 5
sources.said: The anniversary of the birth of the Sovereign or the day, of which due public notice shall be given, appointed to be kept as the Sovereign’s birthday. The first day of January in each year. Independence Day, being the 19th day of September. National Heroes Day, which shall be the 16th day of September. If any of the above-mentioned days fall on a Sunday the next following Monday shall be a public holiday. Boxing Day—that is the day after Christmas Day, but if Christmas Day falls on a Saturday, then the next following Monday shall be a public holiday, and if Christmas Day falls on a Sunday, then the next following Monday and Tuesday shall be public holidays. Easter Monday. Labour Day (the first Monday in May). Whit Monday. The first Monday in August, which shall be known as Emancipation Day. … Note: Sundays, Christmas Day and Good Friday are observed as Common Law Holidays. … 5. It shall be lawful for the Governor-General to issue a proclamation— (a) appointing a special day or part of a day to be reserved as a public holiday either throughout the State or in any island, town, district or village thereof

sources.title: Nevis Island Administration, Public Holidays (page modified 17 April 2026)
sources.said: the Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis honors its vibrant journey through its official National Public Holidays. … New Year's Day - January 1st Carnival Day - January 2nd Good Friday - April 3rd Easter Monday - April 6th Emancipation Day - August 3rd Independence Day - September 19th Labour Day - May 4th Culturama Day - August 4th Christmas Day - December 25th Whit Monday - May 25th National Heroes Day - September 16th Boxing Day - December 26th, 2026
